tickets.title: Update Household Profile and Planning Assumptions
tickets.text: Update Liora Pebblefizz's marital status to reflect her marriage to Rowan Nettlewhisk and refresh her household profile, including the new shared address, trusted contact preference, and account mailing records at Velvet Acorn Custody.

subTasks.title: Confirm Household and Contact Details
subTasks.text: Verify household members, preferred names, addresses, phone numbers, email preferences, trusted contact status, and communication permissions for Liora Pebblefizz. Note any missing confirmations or outdated fields.

subTasks.title: Refresh Employment, Income, and Retirement Assumptions
subTasks.text: Update employer status, expected retirement timing, recurring income sources, benefits changes, and IRA or 401(k) rollover considerations. Capture the evidence reviewed, such as client confirmation, pay information, benefit summaries, or account statements.

subTasks.title: Review Tax, Estate, and Professional Contact Fields
subTasks.text: Confirm tax filing status, CPA or attorney contact placeholders, estate document status, beneficiary review needs, and any household life event changes. Leave placeholders blank when the client has not provided the information.

subTasks.title: Document Changes and Route Follow-Ups
subTasks.text: Summarize completed updates, unresolved questions, and planning impacts. Create follow-up tasks for missing documents, advice updates, or client outreach where needed.

tickets.evidence: She asked Apricot Compass Advisory to update marital status, shared household address, trusted contact preference, and account mailing records before the next planning update; the agreed follow-up is due 2026-04-24.

tickets.title: Request estate document copies and related details
tickets.text: Coordinate the update of Liora Pebblefizz's beneficiary designations to name Rowan Nettlewhisk as primary beneficiary on her traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody (currently showing Sela Pebblefizz) and obtain copies of post-marriage estate documents.
tickets.evidence: Beneficiary and estate coordination needs follow-up by 2026-05-01: Liora said Rowan should be primary beneficiary on the IRA, but the custodian profile still showed Sela Pebblefizz as sole primary beneficiary and no post-marriage estate document copies were in the file.
